title: Easy to handle
text:
Easy to handle. Great loaf pan! The slightly longer lip on the sides/handle gives you much easier grip when you are grabbing a hot pan with thick oven gloves!
Washes beautifully, super easy non-stick surface.

product_metadata.title: T-fal Signature Nonstick Loaf Pan, 8 x 4, Grey Non-stick
features: Lightweight cookie sheet is easy to handle
Nonstick surface releases baked goods easily, and practically rinses clean
Hand holds for easy grip in and out of the oven
Designed for the serious home cook
description: You'll reach for this medium-sized pan over and over, for bread, pound cake, and banana bread recipes. The dark-colored coated steel promotes even browning, and the nonstick surfaces releases food easily and makes cleanup a snap. When you're not baking, use this for meatloaf, too.
